title: Normality part of localized relative normalization
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme whose local rings are integrally closed [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $c:C\to S$ be quasi-compact, quasi-separated and smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $U\subset S$ be open, $P\to C_U=c^{-1}(U)$ a finite etale scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $s\in S$. Put $f:P\to C_U\to C$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$ with projection $l:L\to C$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $n:N=f.\mathrm{normalization}\times_C L\to L$, where relative normalization means integral closure of $\mathcal O_C$ in $f_*\mathcal O_P$ [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization].. Then every local ring of N is a domain and integrally closed.

proof.text: The composite g=P -> C_U -> C -> S is smooth, since finite etale and open-immersion maps are smooth. The private helper normal_stalks_of_smooth_integral_base chooses affine charts and applies [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-over-normal-ring-normal] to g.appLE. The base section ring is a normal domain by WeilConjectures Scheme.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk and integrality of S. Normality of prime localizations of the target section ring transports to its stalks using IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalization.algEquiv. Finite type of g also makes P locally Noetherian via LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian.

Apply [lem-sbc-relative-normalization-normal-stalks] to f=P -> C and the normal stalks of P, giving normal domain stalks on f.normalization. This is precisely the unlocalized relative-normalization step.

WeilConjectures Scheme.flat_fromSpecStalk and Mathlib's IsPreimmersion instance for Scheme.fromSpecStalk (Stalk.lean:89) give flatness and the preimmersion property of Spec O(S,s) -> S. Both properties survive the two pullbacks, so N -> f.normalization is a flat preimmersion. The private helper normal_stalks_of_flat_preimmersion uses Flat.stalkMap and Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom to obtain injectivity of this local stalk map; IsPreimmersion.stalkMap_surjective gives surjectivity. RingEquiv.ofBijective yields a ring equivalence. Function.Injective.isDomain and IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv transport the two properties to the stalk of N. Empty schemes require no separate case because the quantification is over points.

lean.statement:
theorem stalk_normalization_normal_part {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c]
    (U : S.Opens)
    (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : S) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let f := PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
    let l := pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)
    let n := pullback.snd f.fromNormalization l
    ∀ z : (pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}),
      IsDomain ((pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk z) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk z)
